definitions.explanation: A student who is currently enrolled at a school. Used to distinguish current students from graduates (卒業生) or prospective students.

examples.japanese: {在校生|ざいこうせい}が{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: The current students see off the graduates.

examples.japanese: {在校生|ざいこうせい}{代表|だいひょう}が{送辞|そうじ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: The student representative read the farewell address.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}の{在校生|ざいこうせい}は{約|やく}{八百名|はっぴゃくめい}で、{年々|ねんねん}{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: This school has about 800 currently enrolled students, and the number is decreasing year by year.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {在校|ざいこう} (being enrolled at school) + {生|せい} (student). Commonly heard at graduation ceremonies, where {在校生|ざいこうせい} (current students) give a {送辞|そうじ} (farewell address) to the {卒業生|そつぎょうせい} (graduates).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在校生|ざいこうせい}{代表|だいひょう} (student representative)
- {在校生|ざいこうせい}{数|すう} (number of enrolled students)
- {在校生|ざいこうせい}の{送辞|そうじ} (farewell address by current students)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}: graduate, alumnus — someone who has already graduated
- {新入生|しんにゅうせい}: new student — a freshly enrolled student
